description: Ocimum basilicum: a bushy aromatic herb with opposite leaves.

diseases.name: Basil Downy Mildew
diseases.description: A water-mould disease that yellows basil leaves and covers their undersides with grey-purple spores.
diseases.causes: Spores come in on infected seed and transplants and blow in on the wind; warm, humid nights with wet leaves let them infect.
symptoms: Yellowing between the main veins of the upper leaf
Grey to purple-brown fuzzy spores on the underside
diseases.effect: Leaves are unsaleable; plants can be lost within days.
diseases.untreated: The whole planting can be lost in humid weather.

steps.title: Remove infected plants
steps.instruction: Bag and remove plants with fuzzy undersides.

steps.title: Keep leaves dry
steps.instruction: Water in the morning at the base; increase spacing and airflow.

steps.title: Protective spray
steps.instruction: Spray a registered product for basil downy mildew on the label's schedule.
steps.rationale: Protects healthy growth; it cannot cure what is already infected.

lifecycle: Spores arrive on seed, transplants or wind.
Humid nights let them infect wet leaves.
Grey-purple spores form underneath and spread.
